006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
010import java.net.URLConnection;
011import java.util.List;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DocumentFunctionException;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.UriFunctionException;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
023import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyUriItem;
024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBooleanItem;
025import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
026import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
027import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
028
029/**
030 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
031 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-doc-available">fn:doc-available</a>
032 * function.
033 */
034public final class FnDocumentAvailable {
035  private static final String NAME = "doc-available";
036  @NonNull
037  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
038      .name(NAME)
039      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
040      .deterministic()
041      .contextDependent()
042      .focusIndependent()
043      .argument(IArgument.builder()
044          .name("arg1")
045          .type(IStringItem.type())
046          .zeroOrOne()
047          .build())
048      .returnType(IBooleanItem.type())
049      .returnOne()
050      .functionHandler(FnDocumentAvailable::execute)
051      .build();
052
053  private FnDocumentAvailable() {
054    // disable construction
055  }
056
057  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
058  @NonNull
059  private static ISequence<IBooleanItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
060      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments, @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
061      IItem focus) {
062    ISequence<? extends IStringItem> arg = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
063
064    IStringItem item = arg.getFirstItem(true);
065
066    return item == null ? ISequence.empty() : ISequence.of(fnDocAvailable(item, dynamicContext));
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Test if the document associated with the URI is retrievable.
071   * <p>
072   * Based on the XPath 3.1 <a href=
073   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-doc-available">fn:doc-available</a>
074   * function.
075   *
076   * @param documentUri
077   *          the resource to load the data from
078   * @param context
079   *          the Metapath dynamic context
080   * @return if the document is retrievable
081   */
082  public static IBooleanItem fnDocAvailable(@NonNull IStringItem documentUri, @NonNull DynamicContext context) {
083    IAnyUriItem uri;
084    try {
085      uri = IAnyUriItem.cast(documentUri);
086    } catch (MetapathException ex) {
087      throw new DocumentFunctionException(DocumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT,
088          String.format("Invalid URI argument '%s' to fn:doc or fn:doc-available.", documentUri.asString()), ex);
089    }
090
091    return fnDocAvailable(uri, context);
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Test if the document associated with the URI is retrievable.
096   * <p>
097   * Based on the XPath 3.1 <a href=
098   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-doc-available">fn:doc-available</a>
099   * function.
100   *
101   * @param documentUri
102   *          the resource to load the data from
103   * @param context
104   *          the Metapath dynamic context
105   * @return if the document is retrievable
106   */
107  public static IBooleanItem fnDocAvailable(@NonNull IAnyUriItem documentUri, @NonNull DynamicContext context) {
108    boolean retval;
109    IAnyUriItem uri;
110    try {
111      uri = documentUri.isAbsolute() || documentUri.isOpaque()
112          ? documentUri
113          // if not absolute or opaque, then resolve it to make it absolute
114          : FnResolveUri.fnResolveUri(documentUri, null, context);
115      URLConnection connection = uri.asUri().toURL().openConnection();
116
117      if (connection instanceof HttpURLConnection) {
118        HttpURLConnection httpConnection = (HttpURLConnection) connection;
119        httpConnection.setRequestMethod("HEAD");
120        httpConnection.connect();
121        retval = HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK == httpConnection.getResponseCode();
122        httpConnection.disconnect();
123      } else {
124        connection.connect();
125        retval = true;
126      }
127    } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") IOException | UriFunctionException ex) {
128      // an error occurred while retrieving, report false
129      retval = false;
130    }
131    return IBooleanItem.valueOf(retval);
132  }
133}
